regimeSub: August CPI +3.7% YoY confirms Fed hike path; 10Y yields hit 19-year highs as oil shock persists.
themes: August CPI +3.7% YoY vs 3.5% prior locks in Warsh September hike → Reuters Sep 11 'consumer prices accelerate, push Fed closer to rate hike'; 2Y yields +13bp WoW to 4.56% as markets reprice terminal rate higher

Brent crude holds $107.67 as Saudi output slumps on Houthi Red Sea port seizure → WSJ Sep 10 reports export routes disrupted despite June Hormuz ceasefire; energy pass-through keeps core PCE sticky at 3.3%
BOK flags October meeting 'live' on chip boom inflation per Korea Times Sep 10 → won at 1345 despite HBM demand; KOSPI -1.5% WoW to 6756 as duration selloff hits semiconductor valuations
10Y Treasury yields +12bp to 4.95% (19-year high per SCMP Sep 11) → SPX -0.8% WoW to 7656; Q2 GDP 1.5% YoY and retail sales -0.6% MoM signal consumer exhaustion under real rate squeeze

headline: August CPI at 3.7% YoY seals Warsh's September hike as 10Y yields breach 5% threshold; oil shock from Houthi Red Sea seizure compounds stagflation regime with GDP at 1.5% and retail sales contracting.
